property_summary: When the external call to transferFrom fails for one recipient in the _tos array, the reference contract reverts the whole transaction, while the buggy contract does not revert and returns true — this concrete test uses a token that always fails on transferFrom, showing that the reference reverts and the buggy contract returns true.
change_summary: Replace the loop body to not include the require statement, so that failed calls do not revert and the function returns false instead.
